lines.text: Faaa!
Ahn ahn! NEPA!
I solemnly promise…
Good morning, senior.
Good morning, senior. Sorry, good afternoon. Is it afternoon?
Senior, please, is this Theatre Gabas or Theatre Yamma?
Senior! You remember me? From the queue? The long one?
Thank you, senior! When I'm a senior, I'll show somebody too.
Senior, I followed you because you looked like you knew.
I've passed this goat three times. It's judging me.
Is Giginya that way, or is that way also that way?
Please, where do they sell the photocopy of the photocopy?
Senior, how many passport photos is 'enough'?
Ahn ahn! NEPA! On my first week!
My mum said 'make sure there's light'. Mummy, I tried.
Nobody told me the rain here has a personality.
My mum packed six tins of milk. I have nowhere to put my clothes.
…and he said 'fresher, where is your file?' I said, what file?
Is it true they lock the library with you inside?
Third queue today. I'm starting to know these people's families.
Clearance, registry, bursary, then clearance again. It's a circle.
I wrote my matric number on my hand. Then I washed my hand.
They said free meat pie at orientation. I came for knowledge. And pie.
My phone is on two percent and my map is on zero.
Which one is the Clock Tower? The one that's not moving? Ah, okay.
Why is everybody's torch pointing at the floor? Is it a rule?
My roommate said don't take the garden path at night. He didn't say why.
Is the noticeboard always this full at midnight?
Light went three times during orientation. They said it's normal.
I found The Spot! I'm never leaving. I live here now.
They said sit on the warm bench and you'll graduate. Or not. They argued.
First lecture, I sat in the wrong theatre for an hour. Nice course, though.
I called a professor 'Mallam'. He said 'Doctor'. I said 'Sorry, Mallam'.
Candle is now two hundred? It was one hundred this morning!
There's a mall now? With escalator? I'm riding it six times.
The mall has light all night. The hostel has light 'sometimes'. Hmm.
Senior, the shuttle to New Site: is it today, or is it a feeling?
I asked how much to charge my phone. He said 'how much do you have?'
I resumed and the lecturers didn't. Is that allowed?
My dad said 'go back to school'. Daddy, school is not here.
Freshers in a strike. We matriculated into a waiting room.
I've learned so much this semester. Mostly how to make garri last.
Is it true about the video? Everybody shared it, so it must be true.
Which candidate is giving out free biscuits? I'm voting for biscuits.
A senior said our hall is haunted. Another said it's just the plumbing.
They said the clock stopped before anybody here was born.
Senior, you're graduating? Who will show us the shortcuts?
The campus looks so bright. My cousin said it was dark before.
Is that clock going to start one day, or is it decoration?
A finalist gave me her old notes. Full of sweet wrappers. Still a blessing.
FREE MEAT PIE! Where? WHERE?
The talk said 'look to your left, look to your right'. I looked. Now what?
Admission letter, photocopy, photocopy of the photocopy…
First exam. I've read the course outline twelve times. Is that reading?
Senior, is it true the invigilator can hear you thinking?
I can't look. You look. Tell me with your face.
I passed! Everything! Even the course I attended once!
Allowance came! I have plans. The plans are garri.
Thursday market! I bought a bucket. I don't know why. It was cheap.
Strike? In our first year? We haven't even learned the school song.
Which faculty are we? I'm shouting for whoever is winning.
A candidate shook my hand and gave me a pen. I'm loyal now.
One day that's me in the gown. Five years. Or six. God willing.
First Ramadan away from home. The iftar here is big. Alhamdulillah. [Praise God.]
Half the hall travelled for Christmas. The corridor echoes now.
One rose is how much? One? Is it made of gold?
Harmattan has cracked my lips into a map of the campus.
